To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the pigeons showed a regular decrement of matching errors across the steps of the FR cycle and that the introduction of a stimulus situation appropriate to having seven steps of the FR already completed produced a sharp drop in errors in the probe condition.

pigeons show stimulus control over the number of unreinforced FR responses and that the stimulus control is more effective when the stimulus array is appropriate to having a large number of FR steps completed than when it is appropriate to having only a few of the FR steps completed.

the stimulus situation appropriate to having seven steps of a FR ratio already completed was a more effective discriminative stimulus for the two remaining steps than was the stimulus situation appropriate for having zero steps of the ratio already completed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a form of stimulus control that is not dependent on the occurrence of reinforcement.
the role of stimulus control in the maintenance of fixed ratio performance.
the role of the stimulus situation in controlling the behavior of pigeons on a fixed ratio schedule of reinforcement.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a stimulus control over the successive steps of a fixed ratio is established and is of sufficient magnitude to influence the behavior of pigeons.
the stimulus situation is a determinant of matching behavior in the fixed ratio situation.
the stimulus situation appropriate to having completed seven of the FR steps is an effective stimulus for the completion of the last two steps.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the subjects were sensitive to the number of steps already completed in a fixed ratio, and that this information could be used to control matching behavior.
the subjects were sensitive to the ratio cycle as a unit of time.
the stimulus control of the fixed ratio is not a function of the ratio alone, but is dependent upon the total stimulus situation.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the stimulus situation appropriate to having seven steps of the ratio already completed can be used as a discriminative stimulus for the two remaining responses. (PsycINFO Database Record (c) 2017 APA, all rights reserved)
the stimulus control exerted by the array of lights is not simply an artifact of the fixed ratio schedule.
stimulus control of the FR 10 sequence was established by the array of lights and that the array was effective in reducing errors in the probe condition.
